Professional Summary
Senior Flutter Developer with 8+ years of mobile development experience — including 6+ years exclusively in Flutter & Dart. Independently designed, built & shipped 50+ production-grade apps across Android, iOS & Web — every project delivered single-handedly, from architecture to App Store / Play Store release.

Currently at iBAP Technologies Inc (USA) — delivering enterprise-grade utility solutions remotely for clients in the USA & Saudi Arabia. Previously built 30+ Flutter apps at GravitInfoSystem for Indian & international markets. Early career at Xenium Digital included native Android, AR/VR (Wikitude SDK) & on-site client work in the Netherlands 🇳🇱.

Delivered across domains: Healthcare · Astrology · E-Commerce · Utility & Meter Reading · OCR & AI Tools · Food & Water Delivery · Attendance · Billing · AR/VR · Real-time Audio/Video.

Core strengths: Provider · Clean Architecture · REST APIs (Dio) · Firebase · Google ML Kit · SQLite (Offline-first) · Biometric Auth · Google Maps · ArcGIS · Speech-to-Text · Payment Gateways · AI/ML Integration. What sets me apart — complete ownership of every development phase with zero team dependency & full technical accountability.
